jobs_results.title: Associate Accountant (CA Freshers)
jobs_results.description:
About BDO India

BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid-markets with client service at its heart.

BDO India Services Private Limited (or ‘BDO India’) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory & assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300+ Partners & Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi-fold.




The Opportunity

We are looking for a newly qualified Chartered Accountant to join our Finance & Accounting team. The role will provide exposure to financial accounting, taxation and statutory compliance, audit coordination, reconciliations, and MIS reporting. The ideal candidate should have strong accounting fundamentals, analytical ability, and a keen eye for detail.




Key Responsibilities

Financial Accounting

Assist in preparing and finalizing monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with applicable Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS).Support month-end and year-end closing activities.Ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting records and financial information.


Taxation & Compliance

Assist in ensuring timely compliance with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.Support preparation and filing of GST, TDS, and Income Tax returns.Assist in maintaining tax records and supporting documentation.


Audits

Support internal, statutory, and tax audits.Coordinate with external auditors and provide required schedules, documents, and supporting information.Assist in addressing audit queries and closing audit requirements.


Reconciliations

Perform regular bank, vendor, and customer ledger reconciliations.Identify discrepancies and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.Ensure reconciliation statements and supporting documentation are properly maintained.


MIS Reporting

Prepare accurate and timely MIS reports for management review.Assist in variance analysis against budgets, forecasts, and prior-period results.Highlight significant variances and provide relevant insights to support decision-making.


Qualifications:

CA Fresher / Newly Qualified Chartered Accountant.Strong academic and accounting fundamentals.Candidates with relevant articleship exposure in financial accounting, taxation, audit, and compliance will be preferred.Should demonstrate a willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting.Basic knowledge of Ind AS, GST, TDS, and Income Tax.Strong analytical and numerical skills.Good command of MS Excel and accounting/ERP systems.High attention to detail and accuracy.Ability to work independently as well as collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.

jobs_results.title: Cost Accounting Fresher
jobs_results.description:
Job Description: Manager – Financial Accounting & Planning

Company: Me N Moms Pvt. Ltd. | Mee Mee

Location: Mumbai, on-site

Department: Accounts & Finance

Reports to: Finance Manager

Position Overview

We are looking for a Manager – Financial Accounting & Planning to strengthen financial reporting and support better business decisions at Me N Moms. The role combines accurate accounting and month-end closure with budgeting, forecasting, profitability analysis, and management reporting.

The person will work closely with the accounts team and business leaders across retail, e-commerce, quick commerce, distribution, and warehouses.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Accounting and Reporting

Oversee month-end closing and ensure accurate recording of revenue, expenses, provisions, and accruals.Review the general ledger, balance sheet schedules, and key reconciliations.Prepare monthly profit and loss statements and management reports.Investigate accounting variances and ensure timely correction of entries.Coordinate with auditors and the accounts team for financial reviews and audit requirements.Budgeting and Financial Planning

Prepare annual budgets, periodic forecasts, and monthly cash flow projections.Compare actual results with budgets and forecasts; explain major variances and recommend action.Work with department heads to review spending, planned investments, and expected returns.Develop financial models to support pricing, expansion, marketing spend, and other business decisions.Business and Channel Profitability

Analyse profitability by channel, including retail, e-commerce, quick commerce, and distribution.Review sales, gross margin, discounts, marketplace fees, advertising spend, logistics costs, returns, and other key expenses.Prepare store-wise, category-wise, and SKU-wise analysis where data is available.Identify margin leakage and cost-saving opportunities, and follow through with the relevant teams.MIS and Management Support

Maintain a monthly finance dashboard with revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, cash flow, and key working capital measures.Present concise financial insights and action points to management.Improve the accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of finance reports.Partner with sales, operations, supply chain, and marketing teams to validate assumptions and resolve data gaps.Candidate Profile

Graduate or postgraduate qualification in CA, CMA, Strong experience in financial accounting, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting.Ability to prepare and interpret profit and loss statements and explain business performance clearly.Advanced Excel skills, including financial modelling and large-data analysis.Experience with ERP systems and cross-functional financial reporting.Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and follow-up skills.Experience in retail, consumer products, e-commerce, or a multi-channel business is preferred.Success Measures

The role will be measured on timely and accurate financial closure, reliable budgets and forecasts, clear variance reporting, visibility into channel profitability, and actionable recommendations that improve margins and cost control.

About Godrej Capital

Godrej Capital is the financial services arm of the Godrej Group, committed to making financial solutions accessible, transparent, and customer-centric. We offer an environment that combines the legacy of the Godrej Group with the agility and innovation of a growing financial services organization.



Role Overview

We are looking for qualified Chartered Accountants who are eager to build their careers in the financial services sector. Selected candidates will be placed across key governance and control functions, including Risk Management, and Compliance, where they will work closely with business leaders to strengthen processes, ensure regulatory adherence, and drive effective risk management practices.



Eligibility Criteria

Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with no pending papers.Analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.Strong communication and presentation abilities.Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.

Preferred Profile

Exposure to Internal Audit, Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, Internal Controls, or Financial Reporting processes will be an advantage.Demonstrated interest in the financial services industry.Article ship and/or Industrial Training experience with Banks, NBFCs, Financial Institutions, Audit Firms serving BFSI clients, or Financial Services organizations will be an added advantage

What We Offer

Opportunity to work with one of India's most trusted corporate groups.Structured learning and development opportunities.Exposure to senior leadership and cross-functional projects.Accelerated career growth within the financial services domain.Dynamic, collaborative, and inclusive work environment.
